lead: Sathya Sai Baba was an Indian religious leader, born on 23 November 1926 in Puttaparthi.
He died on 24 April 2011 in Puttaparthi at the age of 84.
Below you will find a verified overview of Sathya Sai Baba: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Sathya Sai Baba — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sathya Sai Baba was born on 23 November 1926 in Puttaparthi, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Ratnakaram Sathyanarayana Raju at birth and is publicly known as Sathya Sai Baba.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu and English.

sections.heading: Sathya Sai Baba — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sathya Sai Baba works primarily as a religious leader.
